---
title: "Gradient descent for logistic regression"
toc: false
page-layout: full
---

This explorer fits a logistic-regression model for the course-defined high-CO
label using turbine inlet temperature (TIT). It uses standardized TIT, so the
two fitted coefficients have a convenient common scale.

::: {.callout-tip}
## What to watch

Choose the initial coefficients and learning rate, then take one step at a
time. The red point traces the path downhill across the
binary-cross-entropy surface; the panel on the right records the loss after
each update. Adjust the surface-view-angle slider to inspect the same path
from another direction; it does not change the optimization.
:::

$$
\begin{aligned}
\tilde{x}_i
&= \frac{\mathrm{TIT}_i-\overline{\mathrm{TIT}}}{s_{\mathrm{TIT}}},\\
p_i
&=\sigma(\beta_0+\beta_1\tilde{x}_i),\\
\boldsymbol{\beta}^{(t+1)}
&=\boldsymbol{\beta}^{(t)}-\eta\nabla\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{BCE}}.
\end{aligned}
$$

```{=html}
<div id="logistic-gd-explorer" class="clt-explorer logistic-gd-explorer" aria-label="Interactive logistic-regression gradient-descent explorer">
  <div class="clt-controls logistic-gd-controls" aria-label="Gradient-descent settings">
    <label>
      <span>Initial β₀ (−1.5 to 0.7)</span>
      <input id="logistic-gd-beta0" type="range" min="-1.5" max="0.7" step="0.05" value="0" disabled>
      <output id="logistic-gd-beta0-value" for="logistic-gd-beta0">0.00</output>
    </label>
    <label>
      <span>Initial β₁ (−4.0 to 0.6)</span>
      <input id="logistic-gd-beta1" type="range" min="-4.0" max="0.6" step="0.05" value="0" disabled>
      <output id="logistic-gd-beta1-value" for="logistic-gd-beta1">0.00</output>
    </label>
    <label>
      <span>Learning rate, η (0.05 to 2.00)</span>
      <input id="logistic-gd-learning-rate" type="range" min="0.05" max="2.00" step="0.05" value="0.75" disabled>
      <output id="logistic-gd-learning-rate-value" for="logistic-gd-learning-rate">0.75</output>
    </label>
    <label>
      <span>Surface view angle, φ (0° to 360°)</span>
      <input id="logistic-gd-view-angle" type="range" min="0" max="360" step="5" value="45" disabled>
      <output id="logistic-gd-view-angle-value" for="logistic-gd-view-angle">45°</output>
    </label>
  </div>

  <div class="clt-buttons" aria-label="Gradient-descent controls">
    <button id="logistic-gd-next" type="button" class="regression-sampling-primary" disabled>Take one step</button>
    <button id="logistic-gd-ten" type="button" disabled>Run 10 steps</button>
    <button id="logistic-gd-run" type="button" disabled>Run to 60 steps</button>
    <button id="logistic-gd-reset" type="button" disabled>Reset to selected settings</button>
    <button id="logistic-gd-defaults" type="button" disabled>Restore defaults</button>
  </div>

  <p id="logistic-gd-status" class="clt-status" aria-live="polite">Loading the gas-turbine data…</p>

  <div class="clt-plots">
    <figure class="clt-plot">
      <figcaption>Binary-cross-entropy loss surface <span class="logistic-gd-caption-note">red = iteration path</span></figcaption>
      <svg id="logistic-gd-surface" role="img" aria-label="Binary-cross-entropy surface with the gradient-descent path"></svg>
    </figure>
    <figure class="clt-plot">
      <figcaption>Loss after each gradient-descent update</figcaption>
      <svg id="logistic-gd-history" role="img" aria-label="Binary cross-entropy by gradient-descent iteration"></svg>
    </figure>
  </div>
</div>
```

The displayed surface is computed from a fixed, evenly spaced subset of the
course dataset so that the page stays responsive. Each displayed
gradient-descent update uses all available TIT–high-CO observations.

<a href="index.qmd">← Return to Classification</a>

<script>
(() => {
  const root = document.getElementById("logistic-gd-explorer");
  if (!root) return;

  const nextButton = document.getElementById("logistic-gd-next");
  const tenButton = document.getElementById("logistic-gd-ten");
  const runButton = document.getElementById("logistic-gd-run");
  const resetButton = document.getElementById("logistic-gd-reset");
  const defaultsButton = document.getElementById("logistic-gd-defaults");
  const status = document.getElementById("logistic-gd-status");
  const beta0Input = document.getElementById("logistic-gd-beta0");
  const beta1Input = document.getElementById("logistic-gd-beta1");
  const learningRateInput = document.getElementById("logistic-gd-learning-rate");
  const viewAngleInput = document.getElementById("logistic-gd-view-angle");
  const beta0Value = document.getElementById("logistic-gd-beta0-value");
  const beta1Value = document.getElementById("logistic-gd-beta1-value");
  const learningRateValue = document.getElementById("logistic-gd-learning-rate-value");
  const viewAngleValue = document.getElementById("logistic-gd-view-angle-value");

  const maximumSteps = 60;
  const beta0Domain = [-1.5, 0.7];
  const beta1Domain = [-4.0, 0.6];
  const learningRateDomain = [0.05, 2.0];
  const viewAngleDomain = [0, 360];
  const surfaceResolution = 41;
  let data = [];
  let surfaceData = [];
  let surface = [];
  let history = [];
  let dataReady = false;
  let settingsChanged = false;

  const clamp = (value, lower, upper) => Math.max(lower, Math.min(upper, value));

  function inputValue(input, domain) {
    return clamp(Number.parseFloat(input.value), domain[0], domain[1]);
  }

  function initialBeta() {
    return [
      inputValue(beta0Input, beta0Domain),
      inputValue(beta1Input, beta1Domain)
    ];
  }

  function currentLearningRate() {
    return inputValue(learningRateInput, learningRateDomain);
  }

  function currentViewAngle() {
    return inputValue(viewAngleInput, viewAngleDomain);
  }

  function updateSettingDisplays() {
    const beta = initialBeta();
    const learningRate = currentLearningRate();
    beta0Value.value = beta[0].toFixed(2);
    beta0Value.textContent = beta[0].toFixed(2);
    beta1Value.value = beta[1].toFixed(2);
    beta1Value.textContent = beta[1].toFixed(2);
    learningRateValue.value = learningRate.toFixed(2);
    learningRateValue.textContent = learningRate.toFixed(2);
    viewAngleValue.value = currentViewAngle().toFixed(0) + "°";
    viewAngleValue.textContent = currentViewAngle().toFixed(0) + "°";
  }

  function setSettingsDisabled(disabled) {
    [beta0Input, beta1Input, learningRateInput, viewAngleInput].forEach(input => {
      input.disabled = disabled;
    });
  }

  function svgElement(tag, attributes = {}) {
    const element = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", tag);
    Object.entries(attributes).forEach(([key, value]) => element.setAttribute(key, value));
    return element;
  }

  function addText(svg, text, x, y, attributes = {}) {
    const element = svgElement("text", { x, y, ...attributes });
    element.textContent = text;
    svg.append(element);
  }

  function prepareSvg(id, height = 300, preserveAspectRatio = "none", minimumWidth = 320) {
    const svg = document.getElementById(id);
    const width = Math.max(minimumWidth, Math.round(svg.getBoundingClientRect().width || 600));
    svg.replaceChildren();
    svg.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 " + width + " " + height);
    svg.setAttribute("preserveAspectRatio", preserveAspectRatio);
    return { svg, width, height, margin: { top: 22, right: 22, bottom: 46, left: 52 } };
  }

  function sigmoid(value) {
    if (value >= 0) return 1 / (1 + Math.exp(-value));
    const exponential = Math.exp(value);
    return exponential / (1 + exponential);
  }

  function softplus(value) {
    return Math.log1p(Math.exp(-Math.abs(value))) + Math.max(value, 0);
  }

  function loss(beta, rows = data) {
    let total = 0;
    rows.forEach(row => {
      const linearScore = beta[0] + beta[1] * row.x;
      total += softplus(linearScore) - row.y * linearScore;
    });
    return total / rows.length;
  }

  function gradient(beta) {
    let beta0Gradient = 0;
    let beta1Gradient = 0;
    data.forEach(row => {
      const probability = sigmoid(beta[0] + beta[1] * row.x);
      const residual = probability - row.y;
      beta0Gradient += residual;
      beta1Gradient += residual * row.x;
    });
    return [beta0Gradient / data.length, beta1Gradient / data.length];
  }

  function makeStep() {
    const current = history.at(-1);
    const direction = gradient([current.beta0, current.beta1]);
    const learningRate = currentLearningRate();
    const next = [
      current.beta0 - learningRate * direction[0],
      current.beta1 - learningRate * direction[1]
    ];
    history.push({
      beta0: next[0],
      beta1: next[1],
      loss: loss(next)
    });
  }

  function mixColor(start, end, fraction) {
    const red = Math.round(start[0] + (end[0] - start[0]) * fraction);
    const green = Math.round(start[1] + (end[1] - start[1]) * fraction);
    const blue = Math.round(start[2] + (end[2] - start[2]) * fraction);
    return "rgb(" + red + ", " + green + ", " + blue + ")";
  }

  function scale(value, domain, range) {
    return range[0] + ((value - domain[0]) / (domain[1] - domain[0])) * (range[1] - range[0]);
  }

  function drawAxes(chart, xDomain, yDomain, xLabel, yLabel) {
    const { svg, width, height, margin } = chart;
    const plotWidth = width - margin.left - margin.right;
    const plotHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;
    const x = value => scale(value, xDomain, [margin.left, margin.left + plotWidth]);
    const y = value => scale(value, yDomain, [margin.top + plotHeight, margin.top]);
    const axisY = margin.top + plotHeight;

    svg.append(svgElement("line", {
      x1: margin.left, y1: axisY, x2: width - margin.right, y2: axisY, class: "clt-axis"
    }));
    svg.append(svgElement("line", {
      x1: margin.left, y1: margin.top, x2: margin.left, y2: axisY, class: "clt-axis"
    }));

    for (let tick = 0; tick <= 4; tick += 1) {
      const xValue = xDomain[0] + (tick / 4) * (xDomain[1] - xDomain[0]);
      const tickX = x(xValue);
      svg.append(svgElement("line", {
        x1: tickX, y1: axisY, x2: tickX, y2: axisY + 4, class: "clt-axis"
      }));
      addText(svg, xValue.toFixed(1), tickX, height - 17, {
        class: "clt-tick", "text-anchor": "middle"
      });
    }

    for (let tick = 0; tick <= 4; tick += 1) {
      const yValue = yDomain[0] + (tick / 4) * (yDomain[1] - yDomain[0]);
      const tickY = y(yValue);
      svg.append(svgElement("line", {
        x1: margin.left - 4, y1: tickY, x2: margin.left, y2: tickY, class: "clt-axis"
      }));
      addText(svg, yValue.toFixed(1), margin.left - 7, tickY + 4, {
        class: "clt-tick", "text-anchor": "end"
      });
    }

    addText(svg, xLabel, margin.left + plotWidth / 2, height - 3, {
      class: "clt-tick", "text-anchor": "middle"
    });
    const labelX = 14;
    const labelY = margin.top + plotHeight / 2;
    addText(svg, yLabel, labelX, labelY, {
      class: "clt-tick",
      "text-anchor": "middle",
      transform: "rotate(-90 " + labelX + " " + labelY + ")"
    });
    return { x, y, plotWidth, plotHeight };
  }

  function buildSurface() {
    surface = [];
    for (let row = 0; row < surfaceResolution; row += 1) {
      const beta1 = beta1Domain[0] + (row / (surfaceResolution - 1)) * (beta1Domain[1] - beta1Domain[0]);
      const values = [];
      for (let column = 0; column < surfaceResolution; column += 1) {
        const beta0 = beta0Domain[0] + (column / (surfaceResolution - 1)) * (beta0Domain[1] - beta0Domain[0]);
        values.push(loss([beta0, beta1], surfaceData));
      }
      surface.push(values);
    }
  }

  function drawSurface() {
    const chart = prepareSvg("logistic-gd-surface", 380, "xMidYMid meet", 240);
    chart.margin = { top: 14, right: 16, bottom: 24, left: 16 };
    const { svg, width, height, margin } = chart;
    const plotWidth = width - margin.left - margin.right;
    const plotHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;
    const surfaceValues = surface.flat();
    const lossMinimum = Math.min(...surfaceValues);
    const lossMaximum = Math.max(...surfaceValues);
    const lossSpan = Math.max(lossMaximum - lossMinimum, 1e-9);
    const elevation = Math.PI / 6;
    const yaw = currentViewAngle() * Math.PI / 180;
    const plane = 0.96 * Math.min(
      plotWidth / (2 * Math.cos(elevation)),
      plotHeight / (2 * Math.sin(elevation) + 0.70)
    );
    const heightScale = Math.min(plotHeight - plane - 20, 1.35 * plane);
    const centerX = margin.left + plotWidth / 2;
    const baseY = height - margin.bottom - plane;
    const horizontalScale = plane * Math.SQRT2;
    const groundCenterY = baseY + plane * Math.sin(elevation);

    function project(beta0, beta1, lossValue) {
      const u = clamp(
        (beta0 - beta0Domain[0]) / (beta0Domain[1] - beta0Domain[0]),
        0,
        1
      );
      const v = clamp(
        (beta1 - beta1Domain[0]) / (beta1Domain[1] - beta1Domain[0]),
        0,
        1
      );
      const h = clamp((lossValue - lossMinimum) / lossSpan, 0, 1);
      const xWorld = u - 0.5;
      const yWorld = v - 0.5;
      const screenXWorld = xWorld * Math.cos(yaw) - yWorld * Math.sin(yaw);
      const cameraDepth = xWorld * Math.sin(yaw) + yWorld * Math.cos(yaw);
      return {
        x: centerX + horizontalScale * screenXWorld * Math.cos(elevation),
        y: groundCenterY + horizontalScale * cameraDepth * Math.sin(elevation) - heightScale * h,
        depth: cameraDepth
      };
    }

    const faces = [];
    for (let row = 0; row < surfaceResolution - 1; row += 1) {
      for (let column = 0; column < surfaceResolution - 1; column += 1) {
        const beta0 = beta0Domain[0] + (column / (surfaceResolution - 1)) * (beta0Domain[1] - beta0Domain[0]);
        const nextBeta0 = beta0Domain[0] + ((column + 1) / (surfaceResolution - 1)) * (beta0Domain[1] - beta0Domain[0]);
        const beta1 = beta1Domain[0] + (row / (surfaceResolution - 1)) * (beta1Domain[1] - beta1Domain[0]);
        const nextBeta1 = beta1Domain[0] + ((row + 1) / (surfaceResolution - 1)) * (beta1Domain[1] - beta1Domain[0]);
        const values = [
          surface[row][column],
          surface[row][column + 1],
          surface[row + 1][column + 1],
          surface[row + 1][column]
        ];
        const points = [
          project(beta0, beta1, values[0]),
          project(nextBeta0, beta1, values[1]),
          project(nextBeta0, nextBeta1, values[2]),
          project(beta0, nextBeta1, values[3])
        ];
        faces.push({
          depth: points.reduce((total, point) => total + point.depth, 0) / points.length,
          value: values.reduce((total, value) => total + value, 0) / values.length,
          points
        });
      }
    }

    faces.sort((left, right) => left.depth - right.depth);
    faces.forEach(face => {
      const fraction = clamp((face.value - lossMinimum) / lossSpan, 0, 1);
      svg.append(svgElement("polygon", {
        points: face.points.map(point => point.x.toFixed(2) + "," + point.y.toFixed(2)).join(" "),
        fill: mixColor([231, 242, 246], [39, 84, 110], fraction),
        class: "logistic-gd-surface-face"
      }));
    });

    for (let row = 0; row < surfaceResolution; row += 4) {
      const meshPath = [];
      for (let column = 0; column < surfaceResolution; column += 1) {
        const beta0 = beta0Domain[0] + (column / (surfaceResolution - 1)) * (beta0Domain[1] - beta0Domain[0]);
        const beta1 = beta1Domain[0] + (row / (surfaceResolution - 1)) * (beta1Domain[1] - beta1Domain[0]);
        const point = project(beta0, beta1, surface[row][column]);
        meshPath.push((column ? "L" : "M") + point.x.toFixed(2) + "," + point.y.toFixed(2));
      }
      svg.append(svgElement("path", { d: meshPath.join(" "), class: "logistic-gd-mesh" }));
    }
    for (let column = 0; column < surfaceResolution; column += 4) {
      const meshPath = [];
      for (let row = 0; row < surfaceResolution; row += 1) {
        const beta0 = beta0Domain[0] + (column / (surfaceResolution - 1)) * (beta0Domain[1] - beta0Domain[0]);
        const beta1 = beta1Domain[0] + (row / (surfaceResolution - 1)) * (beta1Domain[1] - beta1Domain[0]);
        const point = project(beta0, beta1, surface[row][column]);
        meshPath.push((row ? "L" : "M") + point.x.toFixed(2) + "," + point.y.toFixed(2));
      }
      svg.append(svgElement("path", { d: meshPath.join(" "), class: "logistic-gd-mesh" }));
    }

    const origin = project(beta0Domain[0], beta1Domain[0], lossMinimum);
    const beta0End = project(beta0Domain[1], beta1Domain[0], lossMinimum);
    const beta1End = project(beta0Domain[0], beta1Domain[1], lossMinimum);
    const lossEnd = project(beta0Domain[0], beta1Domain[0], lossMaximum);
    [[origin, beta0End], [origin, beta1End], [origin, lossEnd]].forEach(([start, end]) => {
      svg.append(svgElement("line", {
        x1: start.x, y1: start.y, x2: end.x, y2: end.y, class: "logistic-gd-axis"
      }));
    });

    [0, 0.5, 1].forEach(fraction => {
      const beta0 = beta0Domain[0] + fraction * (beta0Domain[1] - beta0Domain[0]);
      const beta0Point = project(beta0, beta1Domain[0], lossMinimum);
      addText(svg, beta0.toFixed(1), beta0Point.x + 4, beta0Point.y + 15, {
        class: "clt-tick", "text-anchor": "middle"
      });

      const beta1 = beta1Domain[0] + fraction * (beta1Domain[1] - beta1Domain[0]);
      const beta1Point = project(beta0Domain[0], beta1, lossMinimum);
      addText(svg, beta1.toFixed(1), beta1Point.x - 4, beta1Point.y + 15, {
        class: "clt-tick", "text-anchor": "middle"
      });

      const lossValue = lossMinimum + fraction * lossSpan;
      const lossPoint = project(beta0Domain[0], beta1Domain[0], lossValue);
      addText(svg, lossValue.toFixed(2), lossPoint.x - 8, lossPoint.y + 4, {
        class: "clt-tick", "text-anchor": "end"
      });
    });
    addText(svg, "β₀", beta0End.x + 12, beta0End.y + 8, { class: "clt-tick" });
    addText(svg, "β₁", beta1End.x - 12, beta1End.y + 8, {
      class: "clt-tick", "text-anchor": "end"
    });
    addText(svg, "BCE", lossEnd.x - 8, lossEnd.y - 7, {
      class: "clt-tick", "text-anchor": "end"
    });

    const pathPoints = history.map(point => {
      const visualLoss = loss([point.beta0, point.beta1], surfaceData);
      return project(point.beta0, point.beta1, visualLoss);
    });
    const trajectory = pathPoints.map((point, index) => {
      return (index ? "L" : "M") + point.x.toFixed(2) + "," + point.y.toFixed(2);
    }).join(" ");
    svg.append(svgElement("path", { d: trajectory, class: "logistic-gd-path" }));

    pathPoints.forEach((point, index) => {
      const isCurrent = index === pathPoints.length - 1;
      svg.append(svgElement("circle", {
        cx: point.x,
        cy: point.y,
        r: isCurrent ? 5.6 : 3.2,
        class: isCurrent ? "logistic-gd-current-point" : "logistic-gd-iteration-point"
      }));
    });
  }

  function drawHistory() {
    const chart = prepareSvg("logistic-gd-history");
    const { svg, width, margin } = chart;
    const historyLosses = history.map(point => point.loss);
    const observedMinimum = Math.min(0.40, ...historyLosses);
    const observedMaximum = Math.max(0.70, ...historyLosses);
    const padding = Math.max(0.02, 0.08 * (observedMaximum - observedMinimum));
    const axes = drawAxes(
      chart,
      [0, maximumSteps],
      [Math.max(0, observedMinimum - padding), observedMaximum + padding],
      "iteration",
      "binary cross-entropy"
    );
    const current = history.at(-1);
    const path = history.map((point, index) => {
      const command = index ? "L" : "M";
      return command + axes.x(index).toFixed(2) + "," + axes.y(point.loss).toFixed(2);
    }).join(" ");
    svg.append(svgElement("path", { d: path, class: "logistic-gd-loss-line" }));
    history.forEach((point, index) => {
      svg.append(svgElement("circle", {
        cx: axes.x(index),
        cy: axes.y(point.loss),
        r: index === history.length - 1 ? 4.5 : 2.3,
        class: index === history.length - 1 ? "logistic-gd-current-point" : "logistic-gd-iteration-point"
      }));
    });
    addText(svg, "current BCE = " + current.loss.toFixed(4), width - margin.right, margin.top + 14, {
      class: "clt-annotation", "text-anchor": "end"
    });
  }

  function render() {
    if (!dataReady) return;
    const current = history.at(-1);
    const iteration = history.length - 1;
    const prefix = settingsChanged ? "Settings changed. " : "";
    status.textContent = prefix + "Iteration " + iteration + " of " + maximumSteps
      + ": β₀ = " + current.beta0.toFixed(3)
      + ", β₁ = " + current.beta1.toFixed(3)
      + ", BCE = " + current.loss.toFixed(4)
      + ", η = " + currentLearningRate().toFixed(2)
      + ", view = " + currentViewAngle().toFixed(0) + "°.";
    nextButton.disabled = iteration >= maximumSteps;
    tenButton.disabled = iteration >= maximumSteps;
    runButton.disabled = iteration >= maximumSteps;
    resetButton.disabled = false;
    defaultsButton.disabled = false;
    drawSurface();
    drawHistory();
  }

  function reset(settingsWereChanged = false) {
    if (!dataReady) return;
    updateSettingDisplays();
    settingsChanged = settingsWereChanged;
    const beta = initialBeta();
    history = [{ beta0: beta[0], beta1: beta[1], loss: loss(beta) }];
    render();
  }

  function takeSteps(count) {
    if (!dataReady) return;
    settingsChanged = false;
    const remaining = maximumSteps - (history.length - 1);
    for (let step = 0; step < Math.min(count, remaining); step += 1) makeStep();
    render();
  }

  function restoreDefaults() {
    beta0Input.value = "0";
    beta1Input.value = "0";
    learningRateInput.value = "0.75";
    viewAngleInput.value = "45";
    reset(true);
  }

  async function loadData() {
    try {
      const response = await fetch("../data/gas-turbine-course.csv");
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
      const rows = (await response.text()).trim().split(/\r?\n/);
      const header = rows.shift().split(",");
      const titIndex = header.indexOf("TIT");
      const labelIndex = header.indexOf("high_co");
      const rawRows = rows.map(row => {
        const values = row.split(",");
        return { tit: Number(values[titIndex]), y: Number(values[labelIndex]) };
      }).filter(row => Number.isFinite(row.tit) && (row.y === 0 || row.y === 1));
      if (rawRows.length < 100) throw new Error("Too few usable TIT–high-CO rows");

      const mean = rawRows.reduce((total, row) => total + row.tit, 0) / rawRows.length;
      const variance = rawRows.reduce((total, row) => total + (row.tit - mean) ** 2, 0) / rawRows.length;
      const standardDeviation = Math.sqrt(variance);
      data = rawRows.map(row => ({ x: (row.tit - mean) / standardDeviation, y: row.y }));
      const stride = Math.max(1, Math.floor(data.length / 2200));
      surfaceData = data.filter((row, index) => index % stride === 0);
      status.textContent = "Preparing the binary-cross-entropy surface…";
      buildSurface();
      dataReady = true;
      setSettingsDisabled(false);
      updateSettingDisplays();
      reset();
    } catch (error) {
      status.textContent = "Unable to load the gas-turbine data (" + error.message + "). Render the Quarto site and try again.";
    }
  }

  nextButton.addEventListener("click", () => takeSteps(1));
  tenButton.addEventListener("click", () => takeSteps(10));
  runButton.addEventListener("click", () => takeSteps(maximumSteps));
  resetButton.addEventListener("click", () => reset());
  defaultsButton.addEventListener("click", restoreDefaults);
  [beta0Input, beta1Input, learningRateInput].forEach(input => {
    input.addEventListener("input", updateSettingDisplays);
    input.addEventListener("change", () => reset(true));
  });
  viewAngleInput.addEventListener("input", () => {
    updateSettingDisplays();
    render();
  });
  window.addEventListener("resize", render);
  updateSettingDisplays();
  loadData();
})();
</script>
